local.name: Sham's Signature Masala Chai
local.personality: Uncompromising, bold, and grounded in morning grit.
local.cup: Full-bodied black tea with green cardamom lift and a warm black pepper finish.
local.moment: For morning clarity and days that require quiet defiance.
local.whyThisRecipe: Can masala chai be deeply kadak without the spices drowning out the brisk estate tea? We explored the exact balance where tea stays firmly in charge.
local.subtitle: Bold · Restless · Unapologetic
local.description: A robust, kadak formulation where dark estate tea leads with quiet authority, met by sharp green cardamom and peppery warmth.

profile.aroma: Lively crushed green cardamom and toasted spice
profile.masala: Cardamom-forward with spicy clove and black pepper bite

local.name: Cardamom & Cinnamon Velvet
local.cup: Velvety sweetness balanced by warm Ceylon cinnamon, sweet ginger and fragrant mace.
local.moment: For four-in-the-afternoon pauses and unhurried talks that wander.
local.whyThisRecipe: What happens when chai feels like warmth rather than a jolt? We crafted a softer leaf balance where sweet spices wrap gently around the cup.
local.subtitle: Grounded · Reflective · Golden Hour
local.description: A comforting, velvety cup crafted with whole leaf orthodox nuances and warm cinnamon sweetness made for long conversations.
brewInstructions: Add brown sugar or jaggery to taste.
Strain and allow to breathe for a moment before sipping.

profile.tea: Orthodox & CTC blend with gentle maltiness
profile.aroma: Sweet bakery spice and comforting warmth
profile.masala: Warm cinnamon, sweet ginger, nutmeg and subtle clove

local.name: Hill Ginger Zing CTC
local.cup: Fresh high-grown tea elevated by sun-dried hill ginger and lively aromatic spices.
local.moment: For midday resets and when thoughts need to untangle.
local.whyThisRecipe: Chai can wake the mind without feeling heavy. We tuned the cut of ginger against high-fired Broken Pekoe for an invigorating, bright spark.
local.subtitle: Curious · Energised · Recharging
local.description: A crisp, uplifting infusion where sun-dried ginger cuts through brisk tea leaves for a sharp, clarifying finish.
brewInstructions: Simmer 3 minutes on high heat for lively aroma.

profile.masala: Sun-dried hill ginger, green cardamom and black pepper

local.name: Royal Saffron Reserve
local.cup: Dense caramel liquor woven with royal saffron strands, nutmeg and aromatic elaichi.
local.moment: For celebrations, festive evenings, and conversations that stretch past midnight.
local.whyThisRecipe: How rich can a cup become before it loses its identity as chai? We paired golden-tip leaves with aromatic saffron and nutmeg for a feast of a cup.
local.subtitle: Celebratory · Opulent · Late-Night
local.description: An indulgent, slow-steeped composition featuring golden-tip tea, saffron warmth, and fragrant nutmeg for rare celebrations.
brewInstructions: Warm equal parts water (100 ml) and rich milk (100 ml).
Add 1 rounded tsp Recipe 04 Masala Chai.
Simmer slowly over low flame for 5–6 minutes to release saffron depth.

profile.aroma: Honeyed spice and fragrant floral depth
profile.masala: Kashmiri saffron, nutmeg, star anise and crushed elaichi
